text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...Are you letting your thoughts wander to 
a journey?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
No, it's just that it looked that way to 
me.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I understand. I have moments like that 
from time to time as well.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Letting my thoughts wander to the future, 
surrendering myself to this racing 
heartbeat... It is a most meaningful 
time."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
At the journey's end, a light surely 
awaits— a golden radiance that illuminates 
all of creation, so I am certain—
